target_windows: 2024 March-October frozen common 10501; window_start UTC date

bootstrap.unit: 35 fixed nonoverlapping 7-calendar-day UTC blocks from 2024-03-01 to 2024-10-31 inclusive
bootstrap.interval: 2.5/97.5 percentile; paired identical multiplicities; pointwise exploratory development intervals
bootstrap.assumptions: Approximate week-block independence; preserves all within-block temporal and spatial dependence. Seasonal nonstationarity, cross-block storm dependence and one-year BEST selection limit validity; no future generalization or seed uncertainty claim

inherited_definitions: src/yuntapr/training/scientific_review.py diagnostic_rules; reliability edges 0,.1,...,1, last includes1; rain intervals unchanged
day_night: latest frozen B13 nominal UTC+8 civil clock [06:00,18:00) proxy only; not astronomical daylight; predeclared before supplemental outputs
terrain: NOT_ESTIMABLE_NO_PREDEFINED_SUBREGION_MASK_AVAILABLE; no DEM resampling or new regions
conditional_quantile_set: IMERG float32 > float32(0.1), valid Yunnan cells; log1p(y)<=qlog, frozen32tau
ranking: Exact BF16 score counts and original tied-rank conventions; reject non-BF16 scores rather than round
proxy: p_rain * mean(expm1(32 conditional qlog)); diagnostic only, not true expectation; physical conversion only in detached read-only observer
